mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_customer WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0)

SELECT contract_id FROM oa_contract WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND contract_id > #{afterId} AND customer_id IS NOT NULL AND contract_type IN ('SALES', 'SERVICE', 'OTHER') AND ((signed_flag = 1 AND start_date <= #{today} AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'SEALING', 'SEALED', 'ACTIVE')) OR (status IN ('CANCELLED', 'TERMINATED') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox_event source WHERE source.tenant_id = oa_contract.tenant_id AND source.aggregate_id = oa_contract.contract_id AND source.aggregate_type = 'cloudflow-service-oa' AND source.event_type = 'CONTRACT_PERFORMANCE_CHANGED'))) ORDER BY contract_id LIMIT #{limit}
